article.title: 淘寶與天貓以AI品牌短劇接商品頁，京東另試短劇入口
article.summary: 藍鯨科技報道，淘寶短劇與天貓於雙11推出一批AI品牌短劇，平台提供商品、測評或直播入口。
highlights: 一部家居品牌短劇把衣櫃寫成推動情節的道具。
京東另測試短劇小程式。記者實測時暫未找到購物跳轉。
article.why: 品牌可分開檢查產品融入劇情的方式，以及觀眾能否在相應集數完成下一步。
article.next_step: 以一集試稿核對品牌露出、商品連結和可量度的到店或下單事件。
article.detail: 藍鯨科技報道，淘寶短劇與天貓在雙11把部分品牌商品寫進劇情。平台可在劇內接商品連結、達人測評或品牌直播間，實際做法因作品而異。報道亦檢查京東的短劇小程式，發現其介紹寫有同款購物，當次實測未找到跳轉入口。有製作方亦向記者表示，其承製的部分作品未加入直接跳轉。
article.title_en: Taobao and Tmall connect AI brand dramas to shopping as JD tests a separate entry point
article.summary_en: Blue Whale Tech reported that Taobao and Tmall released AI brand dramas for Singles' Day, with options to link products, reviews or livestreams.
highlights_en: One home brand used a wardrobe as a plot device.
JD is testing a mini-program for short dramas. The reporter did not find a shopping link in their test.
article.why_en: Brands can check product integration and whether viewers can take the next step in the relevant episode.
article.next_step_en: Use one pilot episode to validate brand placement, product links and measurable store visits or orders.
article.detail_en: Blue Whale Tech reported that Taobao and Tmall wrote selected products into Singles' Day short dramas. The platform can connect episodes to products, creator reviews or brand livestreams, with implementation varying by title. The reporter also checked JD's mini-program. Its description advertised buying featured products, and the reporter did not find the link in that test. One producer also told the reporter its commissioned work did not yet include direct links.
